name: Ring Apprentice
body:
You understand the basics of how magic rings work, and can create rings that produce minor effects.

Prerequisite(s): Caster level 3rd

Benefit(s): You can create magic rings with a total value of less than 1,000 gp or possessing the least minor descriptor. Crafting a ring takes 1 day for each 100 gp in its base price.

To craft a ring, you must use up raw materials costing half of the base price.

You can also mend a broken ring that you would be able to create. Doing so costs half the raw materials and half the time it would take to forge that ring in the first place. Upon reaching 7th level, this feat is replaced with Forge Ring.
